meta.name: process:monthly_reconciliation
meta.description: The owner's decision of 2026-10-28: a chain is a multi-step process: an own party's period in one case: its incoming invoices and its bank statements are read side by side, and once they are done, the reconciliation pairs them for the party and the period. Each step runs a case of its own process, a sub-case (run_case@1), and waits until it closes; a paid run of a sub-case waits for a person's start with its cost cap. The owner's decision of 2026-11-02: the invoices come from a folder or files, from a mailbox's emails, or from both, chosen when a case starts (`invoices_from`); it took the place of the two chains that differed only in that.

changelog.note: The owner's decision of 2026-11-02: one case type in place of three alike: the invoices' source is chosen when a case starts (`invoices_from`: a folder or files, the default and the case as before; a mailbox, as "From the mailbox to the reconciliation" was; both, as "Monthly reconciliation with invoices from a folder and a mailbox" was). Those two packs are gone; their cases run on, and their next periods are cases of this one (`replaces`).
The notes and the description without the development process's references; no value changes.

The owner's decision of 2026-10-29: repeated for the next period: a case's page offers its next period's case, the new case's form filled in (the next period, the same sources taking only the new documents, a mailbox's range moved on).

The first version: three sub-case steps (the incoming invoices from a folder or files, the bank statements, then the reconciliation after both) and its tabs: Overview, History; started by hand for a party and a period, each of the first two steps with its own documents.

title: Monthly reconciliation
summary: An own party's period in one case: its incoming invoices, from a folder or files, a mailbox or both, and its bank statements are read side by side, then reconciled.

examples.note: Choose the invented consultancy and March to June 2026; the invoices are the packet of the consultancy's invoices, the statements its monthly statements: the reconciliation then pairs three payments with their invoices.

options.title: A folder or files
options.summary: The incoming invoices from a folder or chosen files.

options.title: A mailbox
options.summary: A mailbox's emails downloaded and read with their attachments, the invoices among them.

options.title: Both
options.summary: Invoices from a folder or files and from a mailbox's emails.
